'''''Ofe onugbu''''', ({{IPA|ibo|ɔ́fɛ́ ɔ̀nʊ́g͡bù|audio=LL-Q33578 (ibo)-Olugold-Ofe onugbo.wav|lang}}) also known as '''bitterleaf soup,''' is a traditional delicacy of the [[Igbo people]] in the [[Igboland|southeastern]] region of [[Nigeria]]. It is regarded as a native soup.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Udevi |first=Obiamaka Angela |date=2019-07-30 |title=Origin of Nigerian Foods: Ofe Onugbu |url=https://articles.connectnigeria.com/origin-of-nigerian-foods-ofe-onugbu/ |access-date=2026-05-06 |website=Connectnigeria Articles |language=en-GB}}</ref> Although it is called 'bitterleaf soup,' the dish is not necessarily an inherently bitter soup, as the leaves are thoroughly washed to reduce the bitterness before cooking.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Uguru |first=Chichi |date=2017-08-28 |title=Delicious Bitterleaf Soup (Ofe Onugbu) |url=https://www.mydiasporakitchen.com/delicious-bitterleaf-soup-ofe-onugbu/ |access-date=2025-12-03 |website=My Diaspora Kitchen |language=en-US}}</ref> The dish is commonly eaten with ''Ụtara'' a carbohydrate-based staples such as ''[[Fufu|akpụ]]'', ({{Pronunciation|LL-Q33578 (ibo)-Olugold-Akpụ.wav|listen}}) [[garri|Ụtara akpu]], [[pounded yam|Ụtara ji]], ''Garri'', and other similar staples.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Jemimah |first=Sisi |date=2016-04-10 |title=Bitter Leaf Soup - Ofe Onugbu |url=https://sisijemimah.com/2016/04/10/bitter-leaf-soup-ofe-onugbu/ |access-date=2025-12-03 |website=Sisi Jemimah |language=en-GB}}</ref> The leaf is also known scientifically as [[Vernonia amygdalina|''Vernonia amygdalina.'']]<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Degu |first1=Sileshi |last2=Meresa |first2=Asfaw |last3=Animaw |first3=Zelalem |last4=Jegnie |first4=Mihretu |last5=Asfaw |first5=Asaye |last6=Tegegn |first6=Getachew |date=2024-03-13 |title=Vernonia amygdalina: a comprehensive review of the nutritional makeup, traditional medicinal use, and pharmacology of isolated phytochemicals and compounds |journal=Frontiers in Natural Products |language=English |volume=3 |article-number=1347855 |doi=10.3389/fntpr.2024.1347855 |doi-access=free |issn=2813-2602}}</ref>
